newsitem.title: USA: US jet edges lower with NYMEX on sleepy holiday.
newsitem.headline: US jet edges lower with NYMEX on sleepy holiday.

text.p: U.S. spot jet fuel prices edged lower during sleepy Veteran's Day holiday trade on Monday tracking lower NYMEX futures and stable differentials, traders said.
New York Harbor 54-grade jet was offered at about 1.50 cents above the print, while Gulf Coast material was talked about 0.50 cent below the print, traders said.

Traders said they doubted a fire Monday and subsequent reduction of output at Texaco's 98,000 barrel per day refinery in the Los Angeles suburb of Wilmington would have any immediate impact on Gulf Coast and New York Harbor prices.
